scope: The Altria Theater exterior at 6 North Laurel Street as photographed in June 2023. Includes the mapped building, brick and terracotta front, recessed pointed arch, paired slender towers, corner pavilion roof forms and main auditorium envelope. Theater interiors, temporary objects, vehicles and streets are outside the model.

originalReview.notes: Oblique broad view showing the paired towers and their light belts, copper finials, central pointed arched recess, brick window grids, masonry base, and a domed corner pavilion. Only the architecture is used.

Closer view of the entrance elevation, light arch reveal, patterned window stack, terracotta cornice and basement plinth. Roofline and front arcade read behind incidental objects. Only the architecture is used.

quallaSearch.notes: Used two clear Qualla CC0 originals. Excluded the older hero photograph because its file credit and the original upload attribution differ. The redundant third view focuses on foreground objects and was excluded.
